# Pesher Psalms Column 4 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 4QpPs (4Q171), Col. 4 | **Condition:** moderate to heavy damage

---

**4:1** "For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His faithful ones; they are preserved

**4:2** forever; but the offspring of the wicked shall be cut off" (Psalm 37:28).

**4:3** Its interpretation concerns [...] the Teacher of Righteousness and those who do [...] His will.

**4:4** [...] He will not forsake them [...] and the offspring of the wicked [...]

**4:5** shall be cut off forever.

**4:6** "The righteous shall inherit the land and dwell upon it

**4:7** forever" (Psalm 37:29).

**4:8** Its interpretation concerns [...] for a thousand generations [...]

**4:9** to them and to their descendants shall belong all the inheritance of Adam,

**4:10** and to their descendants forever.

**4:11** [...] the high mountain of Is[rael...].

**4:12** "The wicked watches the righteous and seeks to slay him.

**4:13** The LORD will not abandon him into his hand or let him be condemned when

**4:14** he is brought to trial" (Psalm 37:32-33).

**4:15** Its interpretation concerns the Wicked [Priest] who watched the [Teacher of Righteous]ness and sought

**4:16** to slay him [...] and the law which he sent to him. But God will not abandon him and will not

**4:17** [condemn him when] he is brought to trial. And God will repay him by delivering him

**4:18** into the hand of the violent ones of the nations, to execute [judgment] upon him [...]

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal rendering from 4Q171, Col. 4. The Wicked Priest (*ha-kohen ha-rasha*) — the chief opponent of the Teacher of Righteousness, likely a Hasmonean high priest. "Inheritance of Adam" — the primordial human inheritance, i.e., the whole earth. "The law which he sent" (*ha-torah asher shalach*) — possibly a reference to 4QMMT or a similar halakhic epistle. The passage culminates in divine retribution: the Wicked Priest is delivered to Gentile powers.*
